:::{#def-channel-code}
#### Channel code

An $(M, n)$ **channel code** for a [discrete memoryless channel](#def-channel)
sends one of $M$ messages, $w \in \{1, \dots, M\}$, in $n$ uses of the channel.
It has

- an *encoder*, which assigns each message $w$ to a *codeword*
  $(x_1(w), \dots, x_n(w))$ of $n$ symbols sent through the channel, and
- a *decoder*, which sends each list of $n$ outputs to a guess at $w$.

This is the definition of @cover2006elements [section 7.5].

:::
